context.p: If you want to change the Wi-Fi network details in your account, you can use the Reset Sensor option.
After you reset a sensor, it needs to be re-commissioned. To recommission a sensor, you need to:

ul.li: Decommission it on the ADI OtoSense™ Server by raising a support ticket
Recommission the sensor by following the process outlined in section 4.1 Commission SMS using the SMS mobile app of the ADI OtoSense™ Smart Motor Sensor Installation Guide.

context.p: To reset a sensor (or to change Wi-Fi network details):

step.cmd: Remove one battery from the sensor, wait for 60 seconds and then reinsert it.
Log in to the SMS mobile application.
Tap Settings on the bottom menu.
Scroll down and tap Reset Sensor.
Tap I HAVE REINSERTED THE BATTERY.

result.note: Note: You will have 3 minutes to reset the sensor after reinserting the battery.
